_note: German (du, lower case; German capitalisation; „…“ for quotation marks), not yet reviewed by a German speaker. The glossary is in docs/translating.md. The Edit view's slide editor and its stage layouts (Bühnenlayouts): shape names, the names new objects and layouts get and keep (short German: „Text 2“, „Stern 2“, „Webseite“, „NDI-Quelle“), the boxes' roles (Haupttext, Übersetzung, Stellenangabe), the layouts' list, the Add menu, item settings and the hints under the canvas; captions in capitals in the English (SHOWS LIVE, SHOWS, SCREEN, NEXT) are capitals here too, and NEXT is written WEITER here, as Next is „Weiter“ (it has to match the stage's own word in tools.json).
